gloss: final reckoning; overall settlement; grand summing-up

definitions.gloss: final settlement of accounts; overall accounting
definitions.explanation: The comprehensive closing of all accounts at the end of a fiscal period, covering all transactions.
A figurative comprehensive review or final assessment of a period of effort, a series of events, or an entire endeavor.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}に{総決算|そうけっさん}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: We conduct the final settlement of accounts at the end of the year.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{総決算|そうけっさん}の{結果|けっか}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The results of the company's final accounting were announced.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}も{終|お}わりなので、{総決算|そうけっさん}をしよう。
examples.english: The year is coming to an end, so let's do a final review.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{政治家|せいじか}としての{人生|じんせい}の{総決算|そうけっさん}を{語|かた}った。
examples.english: He spoke of the final reckoning of his life as a politician.

examples.japanese: {十年間|じゅうねんかん}の{研究|けんきゅう}{活動|かつどう}の{総決算|そうけっさん}として、{論文集|ろんぶんしゅう}を{出版|しゅっぱん}した。
examples.english: As a grand summing-up of ten years of research, they published a collection of papers.

examples.japanese: {今期|こんき}の{業績|ぎょうせき}について{総決算|そうけっさん}の{報告|ほうこく}をします。
examples.english: I will give a report on the overall accounting of this term's performance.

notes:
A compound of {総|そう} (overall, total) and {決算|けっさん} (settlement of accounts). Originally an accounting term, it is widely used figuratively to mean a comprehensive review or final assessment of any endeavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総決算|そうけっさん}を{行|おこな}う: to conduct a final reckoning
- {総決算|そうけっさん}をする: to do a summing-up
- {一年|いちねん}の{総決算|そうけっさん}: a year-end review
- {人生|じんせい}の{総決算|そうけっさん}: a life's final reckoning

USAGE:
In business, this is a formal accounting term. In everyday usage, it often appears at year-end or at the conclusion of a long project, career, or era to describe looking back and evaluating the whole.

RELATED WORDS:
- {決算|けっさん}: settlement of accounts — the base word, for regular accounting periods
- {総括|そうかつ}: summary, overview — similar figurative use but emphasizes summarizing rather than settling
